translations.web: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
translations.bsb: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.
translations.kjv: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
translations.asv: And on the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
